role: Independent read-only acquisition and annotation reviewer

coordinateConvention.sourceComparison: Three paired Labelme rectangle exports match Pascal VOC coordinates after integer truncation, with less than1pixel difference. No ad-hoc minus-one conversion or geometry correction was applied.

visualAssessment.sampleSelection: Fixed selected-cohort indices0,16,32,48,64,75; not selected by model predictions or annotation counts.
visualAssessment.finding: Boxes align with visible target neighborhoods in the inspected full frames and closeups; no whole-image rotation, scale or file-pair misregistration identified. Some source boxes follow colony core/extent conventions; biological boundary completeness was not independently re-annotated.

crossFormatImageCheck.matchingDecodedPixels: Two of three Labelme embedded images exactly equal their downloaded counterparts.
crossFormatImageCheck.thirdImage: Same4056x3040frame with re-encoding differences: pixelMAE1.29/255, PSNR43.30dB, classical feature registration scale~1 and translation below0.1original pixel. No geometry change detected.
crossFormatImageCheck.note: This was a classical image/coordinate check, not detector/counter inference.

nonBlockingImplementationNotes: The operator does not itself compare the variable local-header filename to the central entry; independent header checks matched on normal and over4GiB offsets. Adding that assertion is a future defensive improvement, not a detected cohort error.
Bounded raw extraction writes selected basenames rather than extracting archive paths; no executable attachments were run.
limitations: Whole remote archive MD5 was not checked: only selected entry CRCs and local SHA256 identities are verified.
Exact SHA overlap checks do not rule out resized/re-encoded/similar scenes or unknown foundation-model pretraining overlap.
This is a separate controlled-imaging study, not a phone field test or evidence that all19taxa are unseen in prior training.
Distinct photos may share strains or physical plates within the external study.
Visual QA samples annotation alignment; it does not establish object-by-object semantic completeness or pixel-mask ground truth.
dataStatistics: Counts and box geometry were computed for validity and manifest consistency; detailed GT is retained only in the local QA directory and was not supplied for parameter selection.

cocoCrosscheck.independentMethod: Independent adjacency-based augmenting-path perfect matching. Each matched XML-COCO pair must share category and have every xyxy coordinate within 1px; no lexicographic or annotation-order assumption. No counter inference.
cocoCrosscheck.notes: The prior failed ordering diagnostic is retained. That diagnostic reflects a comparison-order assumption, not evidence of a data correction; no input data was altered.
